snippet.title: Run Like Hell!  - Available on the App Store
snippet.description:
Run Like Hell! is a frantically paced platformer - slide, climb, jump and crawl your way to safety pursued by mean looking guys with spears. 


Dash through ancient ruins, along nighttime jungle trails and sun-kissed beaches dodging obstacles as you go - every collision brings you a step closer to your doom!
